label: iOS simulator runtime assets
guidance: Review unused simulator runtimes in Xcode Settings > Components. These are managed system assets; do not remove their files directly.

label: Shared simulator support
guidance: Review simulator components through Xcode. This folder contains shared caches and support data; mounted runtime volumes are excluded from this footprint. Do not remove the folder directly.

label: Xcode build output
guidance: Close Xcode and review project build output; rebuilding can take time.

label: User app caches
guidance: Review by app and quit it first. Cache labels do not guarantee every file is disposable.

label: npm package cache
guidance: Use npm cache verify first; cache removal requires downloads again.

label: npm execution cache
guidance: Review cached npx installations. Commands will need to download packages again.

label: pip package cache
guidance: Inspect with python -m pip cache info; use the package manager to manage it.

label: pip package cache
guidance: Inspect with python -m pip cache info; use the package manager to manage it.

label: Gradle caches
guidance: Review with Gradle stopped; dependencies and build artifacts may need downloading again.

label: Trash
guidance: Review the contents before emptying Trash.

label: Downloads
guidance: Personal downloads can include originals; review files individually.

label: Xcode archives
guidance: May contain release archives and debug symbols. Keep what you need for distribution and crash reports.

label: Simulator data
guidance: Contains runtimes and app data. Review devices and runtimes in Xcode.

label: Android SDK
guidance: Review unused platforms and emulator images in Android Studio SDK Manager.

label: Android virtual devices
guidance: Review emulator devices in Android Studio; they can contain app data.

label: Ollama models
guidance: Review installed models and remove only models you no longer use through Ollama.

label: Codex worktrees
guidance: May contain uncommitted work and ignored files. Review and archive worktrees in Codex.

label: Device backups
guidance: Manage backups in Finder; preserve any backups you still need.
